notes.title: We've Just Released A New Content Update! - With a 10% off discount
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Commanders!

We hope this message finds you eager for new adventures because our latest update is here! This update is packed with exciting new content updates, game balancing optimizations and bug fixes, all designed to immerse you deeper into the world of Anomaly Collapse. 

Without further ado, let's dive right into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43104816/2899e9c2166828c1174be61aa908527652f47942.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Content Updates[/h2]

[h3]Temporal Rift Challenge[/h3]
[list]
[*]After unlocking Hard Mode, the condition is fulfilled by reaching the Chapter 3 exit before 30 turns in Normal or Hard Mode. The entrance to the Temporal Rift is opened by a special event when the Investigation value reaches 100 in Chapter Four.
[*]The Temporal Rift contains 3 High Difficulty Boss Battles.
[*]Choosing to enter the Temporal Rift will also make the [Mirage of Yore] battle in this game harder.
[/list]
[h3]Related Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Rift Survivor/Rift Warrior/Rift Champion: Win 1/2/3 Rift battles in a run.
[*]Unstoppable: Complete a run with the temporal rift activated.
[/list]
[h3]New In-Game Language Selection[/h3]
[list]
[*] More language options for French, German, Russian, Spanish and Portuguese have been opened. You can select the language you want to switch to from the drop-down menu via [Settings] - [Game] - [Language] in the game's main menu interface.  
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Stray's initial armor was not getting the correct boost in previous updates.
[*] Fixed an issue where an achievement would fail to unlock if you were not connected to the steam server when completing it. Now every time you go to the main menu it will try to update the completed achievement from the local archive to steam.
[*] Fixed an issue where reaching the number of [Hands of War] would not unlock the [Defeat the Wound of War] achievement.
[*] Fixed an issue where Verica was getting less push impact power through upgrades than other characters.
[*] Fixed an issue where game saves at the end of battles were poorly timed, which would cause a bad file in the case of force quitting the game at the end of a battle
[*] Fixed the glitch where [Buggy] was able to kill bosses in seconds.
[*] Fixed inconsistency between achievement negative incentive unlock text and actual required conditions.
[*] Updated the [Crowded] [Overcrowded] status of units inside plots when the unit size changes. 
[*] Fixed a UI bug in the Career Anomalies screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [Energy Reward] recovery value was incorrect.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera would incorrectly focus past [Wound of War] when preparing the skill [Precision Removal].
[/list]
[h3]Feature Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Soma Buffs：
[list]
[*]Added a new mechanic for re-following beast form skills to address the issue of bestialization skills not performing well in real combat.
[*]Adjusted the attribute benefit of Soma's beast form skill so that the life cap now also increases the effect of its skill.
[*]The initial HP has been increased from 26 to 30.
[*]Skills:
[list]
[*]Swing: no longer a basic skill, but has an incremental Health drain when used consecutively. Deals X points (depending on Strength and Mind) of damage to the target. Immediately re-follows all current bestiality skills after use, and re-follows to skills that are on [ Instant Cooldown]. Each use of Increase increases the Health drain, resetting at the end of the turn. (The [Instant Cooldown] resets its extra drain if it is a base skill. If not, reset its cooldown.)
[*]Pulverize: Basic. Transforms into a bear and deals X points (depending on Strength and Max Health) of damage to the target with several layers of [Breached Armor]. Preemptive Shot: -1 action drain. each layer of [Breached Armor] gives +5% to direct damage dealt, up to a maximum of 5 layers.
[*]Suppressive Fire: Basic. Assume the form of a raven and inflict X points (depending on Mind and Max Health) of damage to targets within range, with an additional X (depending on Mind and Max Health) tier of [Bleeding] for 2 turns. Preemptive: -1 action power drain.
[*]Evacuate: in the guise of a raven, instantly move to the target plot and regain 10% of lost Max Health plus X points (depending on Mind and Support). Preemptive: -1 action power drain.
[*]Juggernaut: take the form of a bear and charge to the selected plot, dealing X points (depending on Strength and Max Health) of damage to enemies in its path and reversing their facing direction. Immediately after use, re-follow this bestiality skill, and re-following to the skill will [Instant Cooldown]. Preemptive: -1 to action and movement drain.
[*]Unnerving Shriek: Incarnate as a raven and instantly move to the target plot, then inflict X points (depending on Mind and Max Health) of damage to targets within range and knock them back 1 square. Immediately re-follow this bestiality skill after use, and the skill you re-followed to will [Instant Cooldown]. Preemptive: -1 action and movement drain
[/list]
[*]Trait:
[list]
[*]Sulky: When resting, gain 2 levels of [Rage].
[*]Atavism: At the start of the turn, gain 1 additional  Beast Form skill. (No longer required to be in human form)
[/list]
[/list][*] Increased the recovery value of Mira's trait [Boost Morale] (1+Support x 8% to 1+Support x 10%).
[*]Mira's [Healing Shot] no longer reduces its effect each time.
[*]Balancing adjustments have been made to the values of some enemies.。
[*]Adjustments have been made to the Percentage Damage Reduction mechanic from stacking to multiplying; the coefficients of most Percentage Damage Reduction effects have also been adjusted upwards to enhance ease of use in individual situations.
[*] Reduced the number of chains (20 to 10) that need to be removed for the Plunderer Boss Battle special achievement.
[*] Reduced the amount of goodwill required for the Piggy Bank upgrade.
[*] Explosive damage from oil barrels is now considered indirect damage
[*] Default icon change for neutral buff icons
[/list]
[h2]Anomaly Collapse Original Soundtrack - Now Available![/h2]
In addition, we are excited to announce the launch of our original soundtrack! This collection of stirring compositions not only enhances your gameplay experience but is also available as a standalone purchase. For those who want it all, we’ve created a special bundle that includes both the game and the soundtrack at a discounted price, so be sure to grab them while you can!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42597/Game__Soundtrack_Bundle/

We hope these updates are an added bonus to your gaming experience and we will continue to work hard to ensure that it will be better! 

In addition, we'd be super grateful if you could spare a moment to leave a review. Your input is invaluable in helping us improve the game and deliver the best experience for everyone :) We'd also greatly appreciate it if you could help spread the word by sharing your thoughts on social media or suggesting the game to a friend who might find it interesting. 

Thank you all for your continued support, and we hope you’ll keep strategizing new adventures and experiences in our game!

notes.title: We’ve Got Another Game Balancing Update For You!
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Commanders!

How are you? We hope you are enjoying the updates that have been released so far, and it’s all thanks to the insightful feedback from all of you. As we continue to improve your gaming experience, we are excited to share that we have rolled out another patch that includes even more game balancing improvements. 

Without further ado, let's dive into it!

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new item for adding specific characters to the team: Wish Compasses. When more than three characters are unlocked, a dedicated Wish Compass shelf will appear in the shop.
Wish Compass: When used, it can create a recruitment node, allowing you to encounter a character that has been unlocked but not yet met in the current run. If the player does not wish to change the team configuration, they can also use the Wish Compass to generate a treasure node.
[*] Added a special status display feature. Now, when a unit has an Ambush Mark or 5 stacks of Burning, special icons will appear on the status bar above their heads.
[/list]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the warning number style on the monster skill aim lines.
[*]The recovery value formula in the description of Thriving is now displayed.
[*]The value formula in the description of Tough Pelt is now displayed.
[*]The enhancement values in the description of the trait Empowered Beast are now displayed.
[*]Removed the attribute recommendation conditions for the abnormality Motivator.
[*]Changed the status type of the Reflection buff to a debuff.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the skill Group Charge could not perform attacks.
[*]Fixed an issue where the health of the phantoms summoned by Transcendent Voyager was too high in hard mode.
[*]Fixed the incorrect sorting of abnormality slot unlocks for Soma in the character selection interface.
[*]Corrected the trigger effect of the trait Flanking Master.
[*]Fixed some UI display issues.
[/list]

We trust that these updates will enhance your gameplay, and we will continue to work hard. Keep an eye out for more updates, and please, if you run into any issue or have other feedback for us, feel free to contact us here on Steam or through our Discord channel.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2082410/Anomaly_Collapse/

Thank you all for your continued support, and we hope you’ll keep strategizing new adventures and experiences in our game!

notes.title: We've Just Rolled Out A Game Balancing Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Commanders!

Hope you all are enjoying slaying the monsters lurking in the midst of Episilon City. Over the past week since our launch, we have received many pieces of feedback from everyone. We really appreciate each one of you voicing your thoughts about the game so that we can craft something that all of you can enjoy. 
As such, we're excited to roll out this latest patch, which includes several game balancing adjustments, feature optimizations, and bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience! So, without further ado, let's get into the patch notes:

[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]

[b]Glitch: Buffing underpowered abilities.[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced the cooldown of [Defensive Poise] from 4 to 3, and improved its recovery values from [3+Support×0.2+Tech×0.1] to [3+Support×0.2+Tech×0.2].
[/list]
[b]Mira: Slight enhancement to healing capabilities and usability of intensive reload.[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the duration of the buff from [Catalytic Ammo] from 2 to 3.
[*] Improved the recovery value of [Medical Care] from [1+Support×15%] to [1+Support×20%].
[/list]
[b]Stray: Increased durability and healing capabilities. Buffing underpowered skills.[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased Stray's base armor from 8 to 10.
  [*]Adjusted Stray's unlockable item [Bonus Stat VIII] from “Max Armor +2” to “Max Armor +2, Armor Growth +0.5”.
  [*]Changed [Hammer Smash] from “Deals X damage to the target. Charged: Knocks back 1 square and restores 10% of lost armor” to “Deals X damage to the target and restores 15% of damaged armor to oneself. Charged: Knocks back 1 square”.
  [*]Modified [Tactical Rest] from “Restores X (4+Support×40%+Tech×20%) armor. Post-activation: Each skill used increases healing effect by 25%” to “Increases max armor by X (2+Support×10%+Tech×10%) in this battle, and restores X (4+Support×40%+Tech×20%) armor. Post-activation: Each skill used increases effect by 25% and healing effect by 25%”.
  [*]Enhanced the recovery value of trait 2302 [Urgent Repair] from [3+Support×20%] to [4+Support×40%].
  [*]Changed trait 2301 [Trusted Tank] from “Damage received by allies in the same square reduced by X (15%)” to “Damage received by allies in the same square reduced by X (20%). Direct damage reduced by 20% when own armor is above 50%”.
  [*]Modified trait 2304 [Power in Unity] from “Damage received when attacked reduced by X (10%) per ally in the same square” to “Damage received when attacked reduced by X (15%) per ally in adjacent squares”.
[/list]
[b]Anomy: Increased charge damage. Buffing underpowered skills.[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the damage bonus when charging [Attentive Shot] from 20% to 40%.
  [*]Increased the damage bonus when charging [Snipe] from 20% to 40%.
  [*]Reduced the cooldown of [Rain of Arrow] from 4 to 1.
  [*]Adjusted the damage formula of the terrain status [Rain of Arrow] from [2+Tech×35%] to [2+Tech×35%+Mind×15%].
  [*]Adjusted the damage formula of the terrain status [Rain of Fire Arrows] from [3+Tech×40%] to [3+Tech×40%+Mind*20%].
  [*]Reduced the cooldown of [Weakening Arrow] from 4 to 3.
  [*]Increased the damage value of [Weakening Arrow] from [2+Tech×35%+Mind×15%] to [3+Tech×35%+Mind×15%].
[/list]
[b]Regel: Buffing underpowered skills.[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced the cooldown of [Penetration] from 4 to 2.
[*]Increased the damage value of [Penetration] from [1+Tech×35%+Strength×15%] to [2+Tech×40%+Strength×20%].
[*]Modified [Quick Step] from “Teleports past the target by 1 square, dealing X (1+Tech×30%+Strength×10%) damage. First move: Reduces movement cost by 1” to “Teleports past the target by 1 square, dealing X (1+Tech×35%+Strength×15%) damage. Each other skill used reduces this skill's cooldown by 1. First move: Reduces movement cost by 1”.
[*]Reduced the cooldown of [Chain Breaker] from 5 to 4.
[*]Increased the recovery value of [Chain Breaker] from [3+Support×20%+Tech×20%] to [4+Support×25%+Tech×25%].
[*]Increased the additional damage value of the trait [Assassin] from 20% to 30%.
[/list]
[b]Verica: Enhanced benefits from spirit lash.[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the extra damage value of [Thrashing Spirit] from [Strength×10%] to [Strength×20%].
[/list]
[b]Soma: Strengthening certain skills to enhance the benefits of the random skill mechanism.[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the damage value of [Juggernaut] from [1+Strength×40%+Tech×20%] to [2+Strength×40%+Tech×20%].
[*]Increased the damage value of [Unnverving Shriek] from [2+Mind×30%+Tech×10%] to [2+Mind×40%+Tech×20%].
[/list]
[b]Blanche: Buffing underpowered skills.[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced the cooldown of [Warp Leap] from 5 to 4.
[*]Increased the recovery value of the trait [Quick Fix] from 5% to 15%.
[*]Increased the attribute bonus of the anomaly [Fungal Strain] from “Core Four-Dimensional Growth +0.5” to “Core Four-Dimensional Growth +1”.
[*]Increased the attribute bonus of the anomaly [Death Ticket] from “Health Recovery +2” to “Health Recovery +3, Max Health +8, Health Growth +1”.
[*]Increased the recovery value of the trait [Tundra] from 15% to 25%.
[*]Increased the attribute bonus of the anomaly [Memory Shard] from “Core Four-Dimensional +2” to “Core Four-Dimensional +3”.
[*]Increased the attribute bonus of the anomaly [Fast-growth Recipe] from “Strength+3” to “Strength+3, Strength Growth +0.5”.
[*]Increased the attribute bonus of the anomaly [Bio Prosthetic] from “Tech+3” to “Tech+3, Tech Growth +0.5”.
[*]Increased the attribute bonus of the anomaly [Agent Terminal] from “Mind+3” to “Mind+3, Mind Growth +0.5”.
[*]Increased the attribute bonus of the anomaly [Medical Assistant] from “Support+3” to “Support+3, Support Growth +0.5”.
[*]Increased the recovery value of the trait [Fire Armor] from 15% to 25%.
[*]Changed the effect of [Energy Saving] from “Waives the cost of the next skill” to “Additionally refunds the cost of the next skill”.
[*]Removed the initial cooldown of [Mass Heal] from 3 to 0.
[*]Modified the effect of the trait [Crisis Warning] from “Gains 1 action point when taking critical damage” to “Reduces indirect damage received by [1+Mind*5%]”.
[*]Adjusted the effect of the trait [Snow Form] from “Can move into blocked squares and is immune to the Crowded effect” to “Can move into blocked squares and is immune to the Crowded effect. Upon entering a square, gains 1 layer of Evasion Mark for each non-environmental unit enemy present”.
[*]Modified the effect of the variable [Undying]: Initial batch of monsters are enhanced (gaining [Dead But Not Yet]), does not die immediately upon first lethal damage, but enters 1 turn of Stuns.
[Dead But Not Yet]: Upon taking lethal damage, recovers 30% of health but enters 1 turn of Stuns and gains [Terminal Lucidity].
[Last Breath]: Loses 10% of health at the end of the turn. When killed by a character, it restores 15% of the character's lost health (minimum 1 point).
[*]Displayed the damage numbers in the BUFF status [Bomb] and removed the hidden effect “Monsters take more damage”.
[*]Reduced the probability of [Meditate] and [Read] options appearing in the safehouse, and increased the probability of the [Beta Expand] option.
[*]Reduced the occurrence rate of the variable [Oil Field].
[*]Adjusted the formula for the number of consumable shelves in the store, now there are 4 consumable shelves after all are unlocked (previously there were only 3).
[*]Increased the stats of related monster units in the battles of past illusions (including both forms of the BOSS, Time Cocoon, and 8 types of Shadows; slight increase in normal mode, more substantial increase in hard mode).
[/list]
[h2]Character Unlock Content[/h2]
[h3]Initial Unlock Content Increase[/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased the initial number of passive abnormality slots for each character (from 2 to 4).
[*]Each character's initial traits and the first two upgradeable traits are adjusted to be initially unlocked.
[/list]

[h3]Reduced Unlock Conditions[/h3]
When an unlock item displays incorrectly (e.g., cumulative kills 13/10 monsters), it can be unlocked by using that character as the leader and completing a game settlement (starting and abandoning is also acceptable); it can also be unlocked by having that character in the party and settling after a game.

[b]Reduced the values required for unlocking active anomaly slots for characters, adjusted from "this character has cumulatively killed 5 BOSSes" to different conditions for different characters, mainly divided into three categories:[/b]
[list]
  [*]Glitch, Anomy, Blanche, Stray: This character has cumulatively killed 3 BOSSes.
  [*]Verica, Regel: This character has cumulatively killed 2 BOSSes.
  [*]Mira, Soma: This character has cumulatively killed 1 BOSS.
[/list]
[b]Reduced the values required for unlocking passive anomaly slots for characters, adjusted from "this character has cumulatively killed 10/50/100/150 monsters" to different conditions for different characters, mainly divided into three categories:[/b]
[list]
  [*]Glitch, Anomy, Blanche, Stray: This character has cumulatively killed 10/30/60/100 monsters.
  [*]Verica, Regel: This character has cumulatively killed 5/20/45/75 monsters.
  [*]Mira, Soma: This character has cumulatively killed 5/15/30/50 monsters.
[/list]
[b]Reduced the values required for unlocking profession anomalies (still requires unlocking the profession anomaly system first).[/b]
[list]
  [*]For the second to fifth items, adjusted from "this character has cumulatively killed 15 minor monsters in Chapter 1/2/3/4" to different conditions for different characters, mainly divided into three categories:
[list]
    [*]Glitch, Anomy, Blanche, Stray: This character has cumulatively killed 10 minor monsters in Chapter 1/2/3/4.
    [*]Verica, Regel: This character has cumulatively killed 7 minor monsters in Chapter 1/2/3/4.
    [*]Mira, Soma: This character has cumulatively killed 5 minor monsters in Chapter 1/2/3/4.
[/list]
  [*]For the sixth item, adjusted from "this character has cumulatively killed 100 minor monsters" to different conditions for different characters, mainly divided into three categories:
[list]
    [*]Glitch, Anomy, Blanche, Stray: This character has cumulatively killed 60 minor monsters.
    [*]Verica, Regel: This character has cumulatively killed 50 minor monsters.
    [*]Mira, Soma: This character has cumulatively killed 40 minor monsters.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Reduced the values required for unlocking experience rewards, adjusted from "this character, when acting as leader, participates in 1/5/10/15/20 events" to "this character, when acting as leader, participates in 1/2/4/7/10 events".
[/b]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the AI of [Fungal Snake] and [Spore Snake].
[*] The keyboard shortcut for leaving a battle has been adjusted from Esc to Space in the End of Battle screen.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where acquiring high-tier professional anomalies directly in the game did not unlock the corresponding items in the collection room.
[*]Fixed some UI display issues.
[*]Corrected the translation error in the description of [Common Vision].
[*]After using campaign items in the character detail panel inside the store, the remaining quantity will now refresh correctly when returning to the store.
[*]Corrected the statistical logic for the number of times completing a level without any severe injuries.
[*]Fixed the issue where [Buggy] did not appear in the store.
[*]Fixed a freezing issue during certain kill-related traits when committing suicide, such as [Stunning Bolt] and [Killing Spree].
[*] [spoiler] Fixed an issue where Phantom Soma's avatar wasn't showing up.[/spoiler]
[/list]

We hope these updates will improve your gaming experience. Stay tuned for further updates, and as always, if you encounter any other issues, don't hesitate to reach out to us here on Steam or via our Discord channel.

Thank you all for your ongoing support and we hope you will continue to have fun with Anomaly Collapse!

notes.title: New Patch Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Commanders!

Since our latest release, your feedback has been very helpful in our ongoing development efforts. We appreciate your continued support and are excited to announce that we've been hard at work addressing the issues you've brought to our attention!

Today, we're rolling out a patch with several fixes and optimizations to enhance your gameplay experience.

[h3]Fixes:
[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the controller would not function properly after resuming the game if the Steam overlay was invoked using Shift+Tab on the settlement page.
[*] Fixed a problem where the achievements related to "All Characters Unlocked" could be triggered even when the leader traits and upgradeable traits were not fully unlocked.
[*] Corrected the unlock conditions for the "Vast Wealth" achievement.
[*] Fixed an issue where the achievement for unlocking all characters required a new game to be started after achieving it.
[*] Fixed a potential freeze when a unit is pushed and damaged again after dying from push damage.
[*] Fixed a freezing issue caused by "Wound of War" skipping phases due to excessively high damage.
[*] Corrected the special achievement count during the "Pus of War" boss fight.
[*] Fixed a freeze issue when the "Mechanical Ghost" trait "Hologram" is killed by damage outside of skills.
[*] Fixed a freeze issue with the movement animation caused by "Redemption".
[/list]
[h3]Optimizations:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added in a 2560*1440 resolution option.
[*] Using a controller to select resolution will now focus on the option.
[*] Profession anomalies are now correctly unlocked in the collection room.
[*] Menus can no longer be invoked during chapter transitions.
[*] Removed the attribute recommendation conditions for the anomaly "Ring of Fire".
[*] Damage preview and interaction skill costs will no longer show as negative.
[*] Added a delay to "Group Charge" skill to prevent animation freezes.
[*] "Pressing Attack" will now move towards the target after knocking them back if released while on the same tile as the enemy.
[*] MP display will no longer show as 0 when affected by "Shackled" or other immobilizing conditions.
[*] "Energy Efficiency" will now reduce the cost of all types.
[/list]
We hope these updates will improve your gaming experience. Stay tuned for further updates, and as always, if you encounter any other issues, don't hesitate to reach out to us here on Steam or via our Discord channel.

Thank you all for your ongoing support and we hope you will continue to have fun with Anomaly Collapse!

notes.title: More Bug Fixes & Optimizations!
notes.notes:
Hey Commanders!

Just a quick touch-base following yesterday's update. Based on your feedback, we've made a couple more bug fixes to the game, ensuring that every strategic adventure you embark on is as immersive and bug-free as possible.
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the joystick would not interact after an event battle ended.
[*] Fixed an issue where [Provoke] reported an error when a unit died from impact damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character occupation anomaly could not be selected properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where some boss achievements could not be reached correctly when entering the battle from a save file. 
[*]Temporarily resolved the issue where the Regel Leader trait generating store node conflicted with the Safehouse node after boss fights.
[*] Fixed an issue where using an interaction skill after [Cloaked] caused the game flow to not work properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where Soma's unlock progress was incorrectly tallied after transforming.
[*] Fixed [Relay Swap] issue where starters didn't reduce consumption
[/list][h3]Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the recommendation condition for Abnormal [Ice Water] from Thinking Attribute Recommendation to Support Attribute Recommendation.
[/list]We want to extend our gratitude to you for sharing your experiences and feedback with us, it has been super helpful in helping us make the game better for everyone. Please continue to share with us your feedback, suggestions or any issues either here on Steam or through our Discord channel!

In the meantime, keep calm, and continue strategizing to victory!
